title: TractionCurrentPersistenceDecisionRuleV3
description: Reconciled persistence decision rule under Mode B discrete interval timer semantics, formally holding persistence status at CANDIDATE_ONLY and blocking milestone closure.

decision_rule_specification.defensibility_assessment: The 10.0 ms duration is candidate-only. While analytical models show it exceeds the moving RMS flush delay (1.12 ms) and provides noise smoothing, it cannot be formally defensible or approved until physical rebound profiles, motor-inverter compatibility, and calibrated current scales are verified on the bench.

blocking_dependencies.description: Historical 10 trials recorded with ungrounded 10 A/V setting on TCP303 / TCPA300; true hardware range unresolved.
Curtis 1238E factory documentation specifies AC Induction control; compatibility with 48V PMSM unevidenced.
Raw digitized oscillograms for all 10 trials remain missing from the repository.
Historical t_persist_start values were circularly derived from reported endpoints without Delta_flush separation.
